freeze_600m.estimate_basis: Before the previous job hit its five-minute HTTP timeout, ranks processed about 17M-27M tokens per minute. Each rank must scan 1,502,240,000 tokens; decoding, packing, merging, and retries add time. New job startup and throughput still require confirmation.

completed.600m_interim_eval: Both sides complete at 7,340,556,288 training tokens; ordinary tasks, routing interventions, frozen predictor, and full GSM8K.

test_only_new_submission.interpretation: These were test-only new submissions with different priority from the existing aged job. They are not forecasts for 22160737, and shortening the requested wall time did not improve these probes.

paired_600m_finish_rule: DAG eval waits for both 600M training jobs. Paired completion is max(end_dense_eval, end_dag_eval), then summary compute and its queue. There is no finite scheduler prediction for these dependent jobs at this snapshot.
